Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #419 · 2026-10-28T04:39Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #419 as the one open decision card. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `cd609a4979`):
- Premises hold: the set-wide key is the `'*'` wildcard in `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` (:323); shipped sets declare it in `default-permission-sets.ts` (17 occurrences); PR #27051 is open (+1018/−41) and implements option A. One premise corrected: `high-privilege.ts:96` says a plain `'*'` wildcard grant is **not** high-privilege by itself (a read / read-create-edit-own baseline may cover all objects; the wildcard ban is the guest rule), so facet ①'s "与 spec 把它列为高权限的定位相冲" overstates B's conflict. It does not flip the letter.
- Half-state: `needs-user-decision` + `area:access`, no priority, no `domain:*`; A closes the card, B/C spawn a ui card `Blocked-by:` this one.
- Facets (re-read): ① A adds no edit surface; B adds a one-click broad grant; C is small and can come later. ② no measured admin ask; set-wide grants come from clones of shipped sets. ③ A keeps broad grants off the click path. ④ A adds nothing.
- The seat agrees with **A**: not B (a new broad-grant surface with no measured pull) and not C (cheap to add when a named admin asks).
Prior rulings read: the card's own scan (11 hits, none ruling); no ADR; thread: #27010, PR #27051, #26597.

## Triage: lane `domain:ui`, p2 · decision card stays with the maintainer · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-28T04:57Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. Should the Studio permission matrix get a control for a set-wide (`objects['*']`) grant (B), a per-row "restore to inherited" (C), or neither (A, PR #27051 as is)? Lane `domain:ui`: options B and C are ui-only, and no option changes the spec. p2.
- The director presented it in batch #419 (6460816496). ⚠️ B and C both widen what an admin can grant in one click, a high-privilege classification (`high-privilege.ts`), which is why it is the maintainer's call.

Ruling: batch #419 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「除了插件分发这个，其他同意」 2026-10-28T05:50Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batches #419 and #420 together with 「除了插件分发这个，其他同意」 — every seat letter except ADR-0025 (held for a fuller assessment on #26553). Brief 6460816496. Letter **A, no new control**: the permission matrix keeps PR #27051's shape — each object row shows the grant the runtime applies, inherited rows drawn as inherited, and editing a row writes an explicit entry for that object; no "all objects" row (B) and no "revert to inherited" action (C). A set-wide grant keeps coming from a shipped set's code or from cloning one. The seat's premise correction stands on the record: `high-privilege.ts:96` says a plain `'*'` wildcard grant is not high-privilege by itself, so B's conflict with the spec is smaller than the card's facet ① put it; the letter does not turn on it. Not B (a new broad-grant surface with no measured admin ask) and not C (cheap to add when a named admin asks; comes back as a new card with the ask).

Execution: PR #27051 lands as usual (ui lane, its own review); this card closes `completed` in this act, the ruling recorded. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
